release-radar.actord.claims.json:
{
  "$comment": "What this system claims about delivery, state, and effects, and the tagged tests that establish each claim. `actord verify` classifies every claim from the latest test run. basis: workerd = proved locally in Cloudflare's runtime; stub = shown only against a test double of an external system; not-guaranteed = deliberately not claimed.",
  "claims": [
    { "id": "refuse-invalid", "basis": "workerd", "tests": ["malformed", "unauthorized-route", "unknown-message"], "statement": "Malformed, wrong-version, unknown, and off-route messages are refused before any handler runs, and change no state." },
    { "id": "dedupe-delivery", "basis": "workerd", "tests": ["duplicate-delivery"], "statement": "A redelivered message (same id) is handled once." },
    { "id": "dedupe-input", "basis": "workerd", "tests": ["duplicate-input"], "statement": "A release seen again in a later poll is recorded once and notified once." },
    { "id": "atomic-handler", "basis": "workerd", "tests": ["crash-before-mutation", "crash-after-mutation"], "statement": "A crash before or after a handler's writes leaves no partial state; the retry runs as if the first attempt never happened." },
    { "id": "at-least-once", "basis": "workerd", "tests": ["delivery-retry", "restart"], "statement": "A message whose delivery failed survives the sender's eviction and is delivered by the alarm; actor state survives eviction." },
    { "id": "dead-letter", "basis": "workerd", "tests": ["retry-exhausted"], "statement": "A message that can't be delivered stops after 6 attempts and is recorded as retry.exhausted, not retried forever." },
    { "id": "order-independent", "basis": "workerd", "tests": ["out-of-order"], "statement": "Classification and the latest-version pointer don't depend on arrival order." },
    { "id": "scheduled-wake", "basis": "workerd", "tests": ["scheduled-wake"], "statement": "Watching a feed arms a 15-minute wake that re-arms itself; a wake with nothing to watch does nothing." },
    { "id": "notify-once-keyed", "basis": "stub", "tests": ["lost-ack-idempotent"], "statement": "A notification the gateway accepted but didn't acknowledge reaches the owner once, because it is retried with the same key and the gateway deduplicates by key. Shown with a stub gateway; a real gateway must honor the key." },
    { "id": "exactly-once-notify", "basis": "not-guaranteed", "statement": "Exactly-once notification when a gateway ignores the idempotency key.", "why": "Retries after a lost acknowledgment can duplicate; only the gateway's deduplication prevents it." },
    { "id": "exact-schedule", "basis": "not-guaranteed", "statement": "Polls exactly every 15 minutes.", "why": "Durable Object alarms run at least once and can be delayed by up to a minute." },
    { "id": "production-traces", "basis": "not-guaranteed", "statement": "Traces of production traffic in actord trace.", "why": "actord trace reads local test and dev events only; production events go to Workers Logs." }
  ]
}
release-radar.package.json:
{
  "name": "release-radar",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "description": "Reference app: a scheduled release monitor built from three communicating Durable Object actors",
  "scripts": {
    "types": "wrangler types",
    "typecheck": "wrangler types >/dev/null && tsc --noEmit",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "check": "actord check",
    "verify": "actord verify",
    "dev": "wrangler dev"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@cloudflare/vitest-plugin": "1.4.7",
    "@actord/toolkit": "0.2.0",
    "agents": "0.30.1",
    "typescript": "7.0.2",
    "vitest": "5.0.5",
    "wrangler": "4.152.0",
    "zod": "4.6.5"
  }
}
release-radar.tsconfig.json:
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "es2024",
    "module": "es2022",
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "lib": ["es2024"],
    "strict": true,
    "noEmit": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "allowImportingTsExtensions": true,
    "erasableSyntaxOnly": true,
    "verbatimModuleSyntax": true,
    "types": ["@cloudflare/vitest-plugin/types"]
  },
  "include": ["system.ts", "src/**/*.ts", "tests/**/*.ts", "worker-configuration.d.ts"]
}

briefing-desk.actord.claims.json:
{
  "$comment": "What this system claims about delivery, state, and effects, and the tagged tests that establish each claim. `actord verify` classifies every claim from the latest test run. basis: workerd = proved locally in Cloudflare's runtime; stub = shown only against a test double of an external system; not-guaranteed = deliberately not claimed.",
  "claims": [
    { "id": "end-to-end", "basis": "workerd", "tests": ["end-to-end"], "statement": "Items are triaged to filed, dismissed, or awaiting approval, and an approved briefing is sent once." },
    { "id": "dedupe-submission", "basis": "workerd", "tests": ["duplicate-submission"], "statement": "The same item submitted twice is analyzed once." },
    { "id": "stale-results", "basis": "workerd", "tests": ["reentrancy"], "statement": "A cancellation handled while the model call is in flight makes the late answer stale: it never produces a briefing." },
    { "id": "approval-gate", "basis": "workerd", "tests": ["approval-required", "approval-denied"], "statement": "No briefing leaves without a person's approval; a refusal or a cancellation means it never leaves." },
    { "id": "model-bounded", "basis": "workerd", "tests": ["model-unavailable", "model-timeout", "budget"], "statement": "A model call is attempted at most budget.maxAttempts times, each cut off after budget.timeoutMs; then the item goes to a person." },
    { "id": "model-output-checked", "basis": "workerd", "tests": ["model-output-invalid"], "statement": "Model output that fails the schema is never acted on." },
    { "id": "lost-ack-in-doubt", "basis": "stub", "tests": ["lost-ack-in-doubt"], "statement": "A briefing the gateway accepted but never acknowledged is reported in doubt: not marked sent, and not resent. Shown with a stub gateway that drops its answer." },
    { "id": "unreachable-gateway", "basis": "stub", "tests": ["gateway-unreachable"], "statement": "A gateway that provably never received a briefing is retried up to the budget, then the item goes to a person." },
    { "id": "exactly-once-briefing", "basis": "not-guaranteed", "statement": "Exactly-once delivery of briefings.", "why": "The gateway accepts no idempotency key, so a lost acknowledgment can't be resolved; the desk says in_doubt instead." },
    { "id": "classification-quality", "basis": "not-guaranteed", "statement": "The model classifies items correctly.", "why": "Tests use deterministic doubles; judging the live model's output needs people or a model-backed eval, which CI doesn't run." },
    { "id": "live-model-adapter", "basis": "not-guaranteed", "statement": "The Anthropic adapter works against the live API.", "why": "It typechecks against @anthropic-ai/sdk 1.3.0, but calling the API needs a key and contacts an external service, so it is unverified here." }
  ]
}
